identity.name: CoWorkingStay
identity.subTag: Designed for those who refuse to choose between future results and today's reality.
identity.mission: We bridge the gap between professional performance and the fundamental human need to live life fully with nature, creating sanctuaries where productivity, unbound freedom and creative clarity enables you to realize your infinite horizon.
uniqueValueProposition: Coworking-first — built for productivity for high-performing people
Proper working environment — work zones for deep focus and collaboration
Privacy by design — quiet spaces, respectful boundaries, uninterrupted focus
Nature-powered performance — nature is part of the system, not a reward
targetMarket: Startup Founders / Startup Teams / Product Builders
Content Creators, Influencers, Vloggers, YouTubers, Podcasters
Couples/Friends on 'work + vacation' (hackathons, strategy planning, team building)
Students on 'study + vacation' (grad students, board reviewers, exam takers)

pillars.title: Performance
pillars.promise: Professional-grade work environments for deep focus

pillars.title: Freedom
pillars.promise: Destinations that make it effortless to reset between sessions

pillars.title: Synergy
pillars.promise: Work and life designed to amplify each other

locations.name: Work 'n Wave
locations.tagline: Work the day. Ride the wave. Live the life.
locations.address: White Beach San Isidro, Puerto Galera, Philippines
locations.description: Experience the ultimate lifestyle blend at Work 'n Wave. Located in the stunning Puerto Galera, offering the perfect blend of productivity and adventure.

coworking.description: A professional-grade workspace designed to maximize your output. Whether you need absolute silence for deep work or a vibrant space for collaboration, our environment is tailored for high-performing individuals and teams.
coworking.conferenceRooms: Separate, bookable conference and training rooms available for team strategy sessions or client calls.
technology: Dual monitors available on select workstations
Projector equipped in the conference/training room
coworking.disclaimer: Note: Technology and amenities are provided on a best-effort basis and are dependent on external factors such as local ISPs and electricity providers.

accommodation.description: Basic but deeply comfortable. Our rooms are intentionally designed to be restful sanctuaries, focused entirely on providing you with proper sleep and recovery after a long day of work or play.

locations.activitiesDescription: Build your perfect daily itinerary: Crush a deep work sprint in the morning, surf or dive in the afternoon, collaborate with your team, and then unwind with a sunset drink. Or, on a rainy day, fire up the projector in your room for an epic binge-watching session.
locations.activitiesDisclaimer: Please note: Most outdoor and adventure activities are provided by trusted third-party local operators and are not directly affiliated with CoWorkingStay.

gettingHere.publicTransport: From Manila: Take a bus to Batangas Port -> Ferry to Balatero Port (Puerto Galera) -> Tricycle/Shuttle to Work 'n Wave.
gettingHere.privateTransport: Drive to Batangas Port via SLEX/STAR Tollway.
privateTransportDetails: Batangas Port offers overnight parking for travelers leaving their cars.
If bringing your car, 'RoRo' (Roll-on/Roll-off) ferries are available from Batangas Port to Balatero Port.
gettingHere.parkingInfo: Parking at the hotel is extremely limited. Please contact us in advance to check availability if you plan to bring your vehicle.
gettingHere.shippingLines: Ferry operators include Montenegro Lines, FastCat, and Minolo Shipping Lines. Please contact them or us for the latest departure times.
gettingHere.disclaimer: Fares and schedules are estimates and subject to change by the transport operators.

guidelines: No loud music or karaoke.
Quiet-by-policy in designated areas to respect deep focus.
Coworking etiquette: No swimwear or top-off in work areas. Observe silence and be mindful.
No food in the coworking space (use designated eating areas). Only spill-proof BYO mugs allowed inside.
Be considerate: Do not occupy multiple shared spaces simultaneously.
No parties or heavy drinking inside the premises, especially in shared spaces.
No smoking inside rooms and shared spaces. Please use designated smoking areas.
No gambling inside the premises.
Clean-as-you-go policy applies to all shared areas.
Conserve water (water is supplied from a reserve source).
Conserve electricity to prevent intermittent power interruptions.
No outside visitors allowed.
locationPolicies.deposit: 50% deposit required, remaining balance due before check-in.
locationPolicies.cancellation: No refund for cancellations within 48 hours. Please contact us for rebooking options.

locations.name: Work 'n Lake
locations.description: An exclusive lakeside retreat engineered for deep focus and meaningful collaboration. Surrounded by the serene mountains of Laguna, Work 'n Lake is where teams come to build, strategize, and recharge — far from the noise of the city.

coworking.description: A sanctuary of concentration nestled by the lake. The workspace is designed to minimize distractions and maximize creative output, with zones tailored for solo deep work and team collaboration alike.
coworking.conferenceRooms: Dedicated conference and training room available for team strategy sessions, workshops, and client presentations.
technology: Dual monitors available on select workstations

locations.activitiesDescription: Wake up to misty mountain views, crush a focused work block, then kayak across the lake before lunch. Afternoons are for waterfall hikes or lakeside strategy sessions — and when the rain rolls in, fire up the in-room projector for guilt-free downtime.

privateTransportDetails: Free parking available at the property.
Road is fully paved but winding in mountainous sections.

locations.description: Where the best waves meet peak performance. Work 'n Surf in La Union is designed for creators, builders, and remote professionals who want the energy of a surf town with the discipline of a proper workspace.

gettingHere.privateTransport: Drive via TPLEX (Tarlac-Pangasinan-La Union Expressway). Approximately 4-5 hours from Metro Manila.

Well-paved highway with minimal traffic outside peak travel seasons.
